summary.goal: Build the atomic bridge that converts forming blocks into plan steps, connecting ideation and planner domains.

acceptance_criteria.description: For each block: creates a Step in the PlanVersion (title, scope, description derived from block)
Each graduated block is marked as graduated in ideation storage
Both block_graduated (ideation SSE) and step_added (planner SSE) events emitted atomically
Frontend receives both events and plays left→right animation (block shrinks in NowColumn, step appears in ProjectTree)
Graduation is conversational — Interviewer proposes, user confirms, then API called
Dependencies between graduated steps are inferred from block relationships and AI context
Failed graduation (e.g., blocks already graduated) returns appropriate error without partial state

observations: This is the key new cross-domain bridge
Today ideation has send_to_planner tool which hands off via relay
In tend, graduation is a direct API call that operates on both ideation storage (mark block graduated) and planner storage (create step)
The operation must be atomic — both succeed or both fail
The Interviewer triggers graduation through its graduate_blocks tool when the user confirms
Block → Step mapping: title=block.title, scope=inferred from block.context, description=block.content
Dependencies use existing planner dependency inference logic but seeded with block relationships
questions: Should we use a database transaction across both ideation.db and planner.db?
How do we handle partial failures (e.g., 3 blocks succeed, 1 fails)?
Should graduated blocks be soft-deleted or marked with a flag?

steps.title: Implement POST /api/projects/:id/graduate handler
steps.description: Add graduate endpoint to project router (packages/planner or packages/server). Read blocks from IdeationStorage via session_id, create corresponding Steps in PlanStorage. Map: block.title→step.title, block.content→step.description, infer scope from block.context. Mark blocks as graduated (add graduated flag to blocks table if needed).

steps.title: Ensure atomicity with try/catch/rollback
steps.description: Wrap block marking and step creation in try/catch. On any failure, rollback both operations (revert graduated flag, delete created steps). Better-sqlite3 supports transactions — use db.transaction(). Both succeed or both fail.

steps.title: Emit dual SSE events
steps.description: Copy SSE emission pattern from packages/ideation and packages/planner. After successful graduation, emit block_graduated event on ideation SSE stream (GET /api/ideation/sessions/:id/events) and step_added event on planner SSE stream (GET /api/plans/:id/events). Use existing SSE infrastructure.

steps.title: Frontend graduation animation
steps.description: Copy coordinated animation pattern from packages/ideation-ui physics animations. Subscribe to both block_graduated and step_added events via useProjectEvents. When block graduates: add 'graduating' CSS class (shrink animation in NowColumn), when step added: add 'appearing' CSS class (slide-in animation in ProjectTree). Coordinated timing: 400ms duration.

steps.title: Add error handling for edge cases
steps.description: Handle: blocks already graduated (409 Conflict), missing blocks (404 Not Found), partial failures (rollback, return 500 with details). Copy error handling pattern from @plannr/errors package (ConflictError, NotFoundError). Return appropriate HTTP status codes.

architect.cross_domain: reads ideation blocks, writes planner steps
architect.atomicity: both storage operations in one transaction or rollback
architect.events: dual SSE emission for frontend animation

block_to_step.title: block.title
block_to_step.dependencies: inferred from block relationships + AI context
